projectDescription: Perpetra is a decentralized perpetuals exchange on Hedera that combines off-chain order matching with on-chain settlement, letting traders open leveraged long or short positions on crypto assets without an expiry date.
keyFeatures: Hybrid orderbook model: off-chain matching with on-chain settlement on Hedera EVM
Leveraged perpetual positions with up to 50x leverage, no expiry date
Limit and market orders with EIP-712 gasless signing
13 markets including HBAR, BTC, ETH, and Hedera Token Service (HTS) tokens
Mark price & funding rate mechanism to keep prices anchored to spot
Points and referral program for tracking activity toward future rewards
Insurance fund protecting against undercollateralized liquidations
Keeper-automated liquidations, funding updates, and oracle price pushes
publicApiSurface: previewDistribution(token) — preview next fee distribution split
Vault — deposits and withdrawals of HBAR and approved tokens
MarketRegistry — supported markets and oracle sources
RiskEngine — leverage bounds, margin ratio, and liquidation checks
FundingManager — cumulative funding index and rate calculations
FeeCollector — trading and liquidation fee collection and distribution
Router — entry-point contract for trade settlement
Contract addresses on Hedera testnet for all protocol contracts
